documents.title: Weight-based Morphinex dosing in older inpatients: a retrospective synthetic cohort

sections.heading: Background
sections.text: Weight-based dosing references for the fictional opioid Morphinex differ for adults aged 65 and older.

sections.heading: Methods
sections.text: Retrospective review of 1,204 synthetic admissions. Doses compared against FDA labeling, CDC guidance, and a specialty society statement.

sections.heading: Open question
sections.text: What does each reference recommend for a 70 kg, 45-year-old adult compared with a 70 kg, 78-year-old adult?
